Title: Jeremiah's Temple Sermon and Trial
DateApprox: c. 608 BC (approx., at the beginning of Jehoiakim's reign)
Events: Jeremiah preaches in the temple court that Jerusalem will fall like Shiloh unless Judah repents; priests and prophets seize him and demand death, but the princes acquit him, citing Micah's preaching under Hezekiah, which went unpunished.
